tools.name: prepare_abovo_post
tools.description: Prepare a ready-to-send email that publishes a public web page on ABOVO.co. This tool sends nothing: you or your user send the email to POST@abovo.co (or a group address) from your own email account. No login, no API key.

tools.name: get_abovo_info
tools.description: Get information about ABOVO.co capabilities, URL formats, groups, or use cases.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_abovo_info · Private data: prepare_abovo_post · Public sink: prepare_abovo_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_abovo_info · Private data: prepare_abovo_post · Public sink: prepare_abovo_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
